story_zh: 记者小王每天看三遍新闻广播。他调查互联网上的流行信息，比如百分之八十的人用短信交流。他建议作家写标准文章，内容差不多五百字。顺便说，他考虑写一篇关于广告的小说，大概二十页。
story_pinyin: Jìzhě Xiǎo Wáng měitiān kàn sān biàn xīnwén guǎngbō. Tā diàochá hùliánwǎng shàng de liúxíng xìnxī, bǐrú bǎi fēn zhī bāshí de rén yòng duǎnxìn jiāoliú. Tā jiànyì zuòjiā xiě biāozhǔn wénzhāng, nèiróng chàbuduō wǔbǎi zì. Shùnbiàn shuō, tā kǎolǜ xiě yī piān guānyú guǎnggào de xiǎoshuō, dàgài èrshí yè.
story_en: Reporter Xiao Wang watches the news broadcast three times every day. He investigates popular information on the internet, for example, eighty percent of people use text messages to communicate. He suggests writers produce standard articles, with content of about five hundred words. By the way, he's considering writing a novel about advertisements, probably twenty pages long.
